caption:
What's your dinner on a bad day? Tell us in the comments.

After work the hard part is deciding, not cooking: tell eNZi you're too tired or tap “No cooking mood” and pick from quick ideas, without redoing your meal plan. eNZi suggests, you decide.

WE.LIFE is a Life OS for everyday life, and Food OS is its first module. The link to the free WE.LIFE beta is in our bio @welife.world. This is a beta (test) version.

Images in this video are AI-generated illustrations.
